image_description: A bright yellow maypole stands centrally in a grassy field, adorned with long, multi-colored ribbons (streamers) extending from the top to the ground. A group of people, including children and adults dressed in casual or semi-traditional attire, are holding the streamers and appear to be dancing or preparing to dance around the pole. In the background, there is a thatched-roof building, trees, and spectators under tents.
